'''2012 SoCal Grand Prix Mike Tomashewski DS Contract Killers''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Tomashewski]] at [[2012 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Grand Prix).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Contract Killers / Feared Throughout The Galaxy]]
* '''Username:''' Shewshi
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Grand Prix
